newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids lower.

text.p: Most dark northern spring wheat bids were slightly lower Wednesday, largely in line with losses on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange, dealers said.
"It was pretty dead today," said a Montana dealer. "We didn't see much movement at all."
MGE July wheat settled down 2 cents at $3.82-3/4, and other months were 1/4 to 3-1/2 lower.
Fields in central Montana received more rain on Wednesday, and forecasters were calling for crop-enhancing rains in North Dakota as well, traders and merchandisers said.
"Central Montana looks really nice," said a dealer.
"If the weather continues to cooperate, this should be the second or third largest (wheat) crop in Montana," he said.
Bids for spring wheat increased sharply in Minnesota in response to demand for wheat for quick shipment to Duluth, Minn., dealers said.
